column2: SELECT a.customer_id, a.credit_limit_cents - ? AS headroom_cents FROM accounts AS a WHERE a.credit_limit_cents > ?

column1: SELECT o.order_id, o.total_cents FROM orders o WHERE o.total_cents NOT BETWEEN SYMMETRIC ? AND ? ORDER BY o.total_cents DESC LIMIT ?
column2: SELECT o.order_id, o.total_cents FROM orders AS o WHERE o.total_cents NOT BETWEEN SYMMETRIC ? AND ? ORDER BY o.total_cents DESC LIMIT ?

column1: SELECT p.payment_id, p.STATUS FROM payments p WHERE p.STATUS <> ALL (SELECT s.code FROM payment_status s WHERE s.is_final) AND p.created_at < now () - INTERVAL ?
column2: SELECT p.payment_id, p.STATUS FROM payments AS p WHERE p.STATUS <> ALL (SELECT s.code FROM payment_status AS s WHERE s.is_final) AND p.created_at < now () - INTERVAL ?

column1: SELECT c.customer_id, ? AS body FROM customers c WHERE c.points > ?
column2: SELECT c.customer_id, ? AS body FROM customers AS c WHERE c.points > ?

column1: SELECT r.refund_id FROM refunds r WHERE (r.order_id, r.customer_id) = ANY (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.STATUS = ?)
column2: SELECT r.refund_id FROM refunds AS r WHERE (r.order_id, r.customer_id) = ANY (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders AS o WHERE o.STATUS = ?)

column1: SELECT customer_id, SUM (total_cents) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE created_at >= date_trunc (?, now ()) GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM (total_cents) >= ?
column2: SELECT customer_id, SUM (total_cents) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE created_at >= date_trunc (?, now ()) GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM (total_cents) >= ?
